description: Which survivors are worth reading, and in what batches. Survival is a filter, not an endorsement — a test that pins today's wrong answer kills every mutant — so this returns survivors below the mutation-score threshold plus a deterministic audit sample of the rest, batched under a token cap. The threshold is per language and defaults accordingly: a Swift score is computed over one or two mutants against TypeScript's six to twelve. Reads a finished run off disk; no worker tokens.

audit_fraction.description: of the survivors above the threshold; default 0.1

max_batch_tokens.description: estimated input tokens per batch; default 12000

run_id.description: defaults to the most recent run under .sidecrew/runs

threshold.description: overrides the per-language default (0.6 TypeScript, 1.0 Swift)

name: sidecrew_review
